description.html: This glass terrarium (80x50x60 cm, 240 L) comes with exterior decorative film in a pattern of your choice. The glass gives a clear view of the inside, while film on three sides gives the animals a sense of security.

With a floor area of 80x50 cm, this terrarium allows natural movement for ground-dwelling species and proper temperature zoning: a warm spot under the spot lamp and a cooler area on the opposite side. The ventilation system with a protective mesh keeps fresh air flowing and prevents moisture buildup.

When ordering, you choose the film pattern and the shape of the 3D background. We handmake all our terrariums in Novi Sad, so customization is always possible, from dimensions to the way it opens. We ship by courier throughout Serbia.
